prompt: A long banquet table photographed from the side in a single continuous frame, symbolizing the same shared world. On the left side of the table: an overwhelming display of excess — mountains of food including whole roasted meats, overflowing fruit, bread, towering desserts, champagne glasses, all bathed in warm golden candlelight, rich textures, abundance spilling over the edges of the table onto the floor, but no visible faces, only hands casually eating and indulging without urgency. On the right side of the same table: extreme emptiness and hunger — emaciated children and adults with thin fragile bodies, hollow eyes, visible ribcages, reaching desperately across the table with trembling hands, their side of the table completely bare, dark, cold, no plates, no food, no light. A clear physical gap exists at the center of the table where the food ends, emphasizing distance and inaccessibility — the starving cannot reach the abundance despite being at the same table. Lighting contrast: left side warm, golden, rich; right side cold, dim, desaturated, fading into darkness. Shot straight-on like a documentary photograph, 24mm wide angle, deep perspective, highly detailed, photorealistic, cinematic, brutal and emotionally devastating, focus on contrast between abundance and inaccessibility, no text, no labels, no charts, no infographic.
dataset_name: Global Hunger and Food Insecurity Statistics
insight: Food exists in abundance globally, yet millions remain hungry due to unequal access rather than absolute scarcity.
